endpoint_label_counting.closed_same_colour_identity: C_same=sum_{K-triangles Delta} c(Delta), where c(Delta) is the number of its same-endpoint-colour corners

frozen_order8_overlap_count.motif: unordered K-wedge (U,T,V), centred at T, with T disjoint from U,V and |U intersect V|=1; split by equality of the two unmatched endpoints in T
frozen_order8_overlap_count.universal_same_overlap_identity: x8[57358896]=sum_r D(r)=n3-z11/4; the unique same-colour overlap role is precisely a pair of X-neighbours with a common unmatched outer point, hence one Y[r,beta]=2 event
frozen_order8_overlap_count.interpretation: The frozen order-eight layer fixes only the overlapping-outer-triangle part.  Whether a pairwise-disjoint same-colour wedge closes by a K edge is an order-nine datum.

M2_edge_equation.for_a_K_edge_TU: a-b-c+d=-13, with a,b the +1/-1 relations from U into P(T), c,d the +1/-1 relations from U into K(T)\{U}

targeted_three_triangle_scan.conclusion: For a K triangle, local lambda/mu upper caps plus prism absence allow 0, 1, or 2 equal-endpoint corners; they exclude 3. These nine-vertex controls do not impose all 231 projector rows or completion to a 99-vertex graph.

claim_boundary.reason: The exact control has the complete 4,+1,0,-1 row alphabet at all 231 points and satisfies the full centre row of M^2=21M, but has d=0 and hence no K triangle through that centre.  Frozen H8 data only removes/counts union-order-eight wedges; closure of the remaining disjoint wedges has union order nine.
claim_boundary.qualification: The control intentionally fails other rows of M^2=21M and is not claimed to be a global integral projector, flag graph, or SRG completion.
claim_boundary.smallest_missing_constraint: A cross-centre/order-nine constraint coupling the three endpoint partitions on a K triangle, or simultaneous validity of non-centre rows of M^2=21M with those partitions.
